listing.title: My First Camping Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Camping Pages – Tent, Campfire, Canoe, Raccoon & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly camping pictures!

Little hands color 30 pages from the campsite, from a tent, a campfire and a cozy cabin to a canoe on the water, s'mores and a raccoon. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a happy face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Around the campsite: Tent, Campfire, Firewood, Cabin, Camper, Hammock, Camp Chair, Trail Sign and Picnic Basket
  • Campfire treats: Marshmallow and S'mores
  • Camping gear: Sleeping Bag, Flashlight, Compass, Map, Binoculars, Hiking Boot, Water Bottle and Cooler
  • On the water: Canoe, Paddle, Life Jacket, Fishing Rod and Tackle Box
  • Woodland animals: Raccoon, Deer, Squirrel, Beaver, Moose and Bat
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
